system.description:
You use your enemy's mind against them, causing them searing pain. Target a creature within range, aggravating their already fragile mind. On a failed Magykal Resistance, the target takes damage equal to [Arcana x 3]. For every Harmful and Debilitating Condition a target is suffering from when targeted with this ability, they take additional damage equal to [Arcana].

If a creature is Unconscious, they automatically fail the Magykal Resistance this ability forces.
